title: Department of Social Justice and Disabled Welfare, MP
eligibility: Senior citizens, Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan), and destitute residents
benefits: Disability pensions, assistive device distribution, and social security pensions
application_process: Apply via Sparsh Portal or Social Security Portal (socialsecurity.mp.gov.in)
important_sections_or_clauses: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
